subject: Request: temporary log retention extension for HealthBridge audit
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir.rao@healthbridge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: privacy-ops@healthbridge.com
Date: Fri, 2 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Request: temporary log retention extension for HealthBridge audit

Hi Ben,

Heads up — HealthBridge has an upcoming regulatory audit and we need a short-term extension to the log and backup retention window for a scoped set of customer data. Audit team is requesting:

- Hold deletion of backups and KV logs for account scope HB-7942 for 45 days (samples attached).
- Evidence of when backups are currently purged and the exact deletion workflow for snapshots and KV logs.
- Confirmation whether any subprocessors (HelixCloud, LogStream Inc.) will continue to retain copies during the hold.
- If possible, a signed DPA addendum or a short attestation that the temporary hold will be enforced and will not be exceeded.

Can you confirm what Redwood needs from us (formal request, PO, DocuSign) and whether you can pause the scheduled purge that runs next week? I attached our evidence_request form for scope and a short spreadsheet of the customer IDs.

Thanks — appreciate a quick reply, we need to lock this in with audit by EOD Monday.

Samir Rao
Head of Compliance Ops, HealthBridge
samir.rao@healthbridge.com
(415) 555-0143

Attachments: healthbridge_evidence_request.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir.rao@healthbridge.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 2 Jun 2028 12:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary log retention extension for HealthBridge audit

On Fri, Jun 2, 2028 at 09:12 AM Samir Rao <samir.rao@healthbridge.com> wrote:
> Hi Ben,
> 
> Heads up — HealthBridge has an upcoming regulatory audit and we need a short-term extension to the log and backup retention window for a scoped set of customer data.

Hi Samir — thanks for the clear scope and the attachment. We can support a temporary hold; propose the following short action plan:

1) Immediate pause on scheduled background purge for the listed account scope (HB-7942) in us-east-1. Purge will be set to "deferred-hold" until we confirm final end date.
2) Create a snapshot hold (immutable tag) across backups for HB-7942 and mark associated KV logs as "do-not-delete" in the retention runner.
3) Provide a one-page attestation and a DPA addendum template for HealthBridge legal to sign — we will coordinate DocuSign.
4) Provide an export of the backup manifest and a runbook of the deletion workflow for auditors.

Immediate asks from your side to make this operational:
- Confirm the exact list of account IDs and the end date you want the hold to run to (we suggested 45 days, we can do 60 days if auditors need it).
- Please confirm whether the scope includes snapshots stored with LogStream Inc. and HelixCloud (we will reach out to subprocessors once scope confirmed).

Attachments: tmp_retention_runbook_v1.md; backup_manifest_q2.csv (attachment stubs)

I'll assign Kimberly and Marissa to lead the hold and Karthik will coordinate the legal/Docusign path. Kimber, Marissa, can you take point on infra work?

Ben
Sr. Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Samir Rao <samir.rao@healthbridge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: privacy-ops@healthbridge.com
Date: Mon, 5 Jun 2028 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary log retention extension for HealthBridge audit

Ben — thanks for the quick reply. Couple clarifying points from audit: 

- Please include KV cache logs and write-ahead logs produced by HelixCloud subprocessor — auditors will want to see chain-of-custody.
- Are KMS/HSM access logs included in the hold (we need to show key usage for the retained windows)?
- We'll accept 60 days if that simplifies your ops; please reflect the end date in the attestation.

I've attached an audit_scope.xlsx that marks the exact customer IDs and a column for whether HelixCloud holds copies. We will also route a DocuSign to finalize the DPA addendum once you send the template.

Samir

Attachments: audit_scope.xlsx
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir.rao@healthbridge.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 5 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary log retention extension for HealthBridge audit

Samir — quick update and confirmations.

- We have paused the scheduled purge job for HB-7942 (effective immediately).
- Proposed hold period: 2028-06-05 through 2028-08-04 (60 days). Purge resume will be staged and executed over a 7-day window to avoid throughput spikes; final delete completes 2028-08-11 unless HealthBridge requests an earlier resume.
- Scope: backups (snapshots), KV cache exports, write-ahead logs, and KMS access logs will be included. HelixCloud and LogStream Inc. have been notified; they confirmed they will hold copies under the same hold label and will not perform retention deletions for the tagged objects.

Operational notes (runbook excerpt):
- Step 1: infra pauses retention job (done).
- Step 2: apply "hb-audit-hold-20280605" tag to snapshot objects and propagate to subprocessor manifests (tmp_retention_runbook_v1.md).
- Step 3: extract backup_manifest_q2.csv for auditor export and generate per-customer evidence bundles.
- Step 4: Karthik to push DPA addendum to DocuSign (link will be provided).
- Step 5: After hold end, run a staged-prune over 7 days with pre- and post-checks in the console.

Deliverables we will send within 24 hours:
- One-page attestation signed by Redwood legal.
- Backup manifest CSV and per-account evidence bundle.
- DocuSign link for the DPA addendum: DocuSign-4567 (we will post the full URL here once ready).

Ben/Karthik/Marissa: please track HS-98321 and confirm when DocuSign is sent. Samir: if the auditors need a higher level of assurance (e.g., HSM attestation) call that out in the Docusign comment and we will escalate to Security.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
